app.name: OmniFamily Nexus
app.tagline: Your family calendar, tasks and chores — on this device, no account needed.

onboarding.title: Set up your family
onboarding.intro: Everything stays on this device. No email, no password, no account.
onboarding.pinHint: 4–8 digits. Leave empty to skip; you can add one later in Settings.
onboarding.pinDisclosure: A 4-digit PIN has ~10⁴ entropy and is a UX speed bump on a shared screen, not a security boundary.
onboarding.storageDisclosure: IndexedDB is not encrypted at rest in v1; the app relies on OS-level device encryption.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lastParent: The last parent cannot be removed.
settings.parentGate: Settings are for parents. Choose a parent to unlock.
